meta.name: trojan_horse_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: A monumental wooden horse construct built from weathered pine and oak hull planks (`api.theme.wood.planks` and stripped logs), resting on heavy timber skid beams with wooden wheels, with an unlatched trapdoor seam in the belly and rope tethers, standing in triumph before the citadel gates.

tokens.terrain: a walled citadel city on a tell rise above a coastal plain, with the Aegean shore in view
tokens.icons: a colossal wooden horse standing in the public square just inside the Scaean gate; massive stone ramparts and watchtowers; royal megaron palace at the citadel summit; abandoned Greek siege camp and beached ship traces on the distant shore
tokens.event_direction: the wooden horse brought inside the main gates, looming over the silent evening streets before the soldiers emerge
